column8: ∀ (base : Minidregg.Pred.Pred) (old new : Minidregg.Pred.State), new.get Minidregg.Kernel.PayClaimLaw.operationSlot = Option.some 1 → new.get Minidregg.Kernel.PayClaimLaw.authorizedSlot ≠ Option.some 1 → Minidregg.Pred.eval (Minidregg.Kernel.PayClaimLaw.extend base) old new = Bool.false

∀ (base : Minidregg.Pred.Pred) (old new : Minidregg.Pred.State), new.get Minidregg.Kernel.PayClaimLaw.operationSlot = Option.some 1 → new.get Minidregg.Kernel.PayClaimLaw.authorizedSlot = Option.some 1 → Minidregg.Pred.eval (Minidregg.Kernel.PayClaimLaw.extend base) old new = Bool.true

∀ (inherited base : Minidregg.Pred.Pred) (old new : Minidregg.Pred.State), Minidregg.Pred.eval (Minidregg.Pred.Pred.all [inherited, Minidregg.Kernel.PayClaimLaw.extend base]) old new = Bool.true → Minidregg.Pred.eval inherited old new = Bool.true

∀ (base : Minidregg.Pred.Pred) (old new : Minidregg.Pred.State), new.get Minidregg.Kernel.PayClaimLaw.operationSlot = Option.none → Minidregg.Pred.eval (Minidregg.Kernel.PayClaimLaw.extend base) old new = Minidregg.Pred.eval base old new
